Found 21 items in registries @agentui:

Showing items 1-21 of 21:

- model-selector (registry:component) - A composer-ready model and reasoning-effort control: the first view manages effort, the current model opens a full picker, and both views share a stable collision-aware panel with complete pointer and keyboard navigation. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- usage-dashboard (registry:component) - A coding-agent usage overview with daily token trends, provider and model totals, billed spend, and a daily breakdown. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- message-bubble (registry:component) - A focused conversational surface with visual tones, independent alignment, grouped messages, expandable content, and interactive link or button support. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- message (registry:component) - Composable conversation primitives for message rows, grouped bubbles, avatars, metadata, live markers, and a mount-only trailing-edge pop-up for newly sent rows. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- message-scroller (registry:component) - A reader-aware conversation viewport that follows streamed output at the live edge and releases control when the reader moves away. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- prompt-input (registry:component) - An auto-growing agent composer with prompt actions, model selection, keyboard submission, and animated send and stop states. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- todo-list (registry:component) - A collapsible agent task plan with morphing status marks, a completion count, compact metadata, and smooth list updates. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- code-block (registry:component) - A syntax-highlighted code surface with stable streaming updates, line numbers, focused lines, smooth following, and copy feedback. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- approval-card (registry:component) - A human-in-the-loop decision surface for approvals, single or multiple-choice questions, custom responses, and multi-step review flows. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- file-diff (registry:component) - A syntax-highlighted file change disclosure with progressive rows, line numbers, live change counts, smooth following, and completion collapse. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tool-result (registry:component) - A lightweight execution disclosure for syntax-highlighted terminal output and request responses that collapses into a compact completed state. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- streaming-response (registry:component) - A stable response surface with completion actions, rendered content, and an expandable source summary. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- image-generation (registry:component) - A stable generated-image surface that moves from queued work through progressive refinement to a completed result without layout shift. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tool-approval (registry:component) - A human-in-the-loop permission card for reviewing tool details, allowing once, remembering access, or denying execution. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- citations (registry:component) - Inline citation markers paired with a collapsible, progressively rendered reference collection for grounded agent responses. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-activity (registry:component) - One adaptive activity stream for reasoning, searches, tool calls, structured execution traces, or a chronological mix. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- reasoning-text (registry:component) - Shimmering reasoning copy with an ASCII loader and cascade, phrase-swap, or per-letter scramble transitions. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- thinking-shimmer (registry:component) - A quiet shimmer that keeps the agent's current status readable while work continues. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-progress (registry:component) - A compact activity glyph, action verb, and live tabular timer for longer-running agent work. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ai-sidebar (registry:component) - A collapsible AI workspace sidebar for folders, projects, files, and bookmarks with keyboard navigation, optimistic moves, inline rename, and overflow-aware labels. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chat-app (registry:component) - A complete agent conversation workspace composing navigation, messages, streaming, planning, approvals, tools, code, diffs, generated media, sources, and prompt input. [@agentui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
